a2_update.description: Step A2/E (documented statutory bug fixes per tax-expert rulings, 2026-10-31): only the annotated cells were re-pinned — surcharge band-based marginal relief at all four thresholds, the s.115BAC(6) 15% special-rate surcharge cap (new regime), and the harmonized 87A (TI-keyed eligibility, post-cess band cap). Every other cell is byte-identical to the A1 snapshot; verify with git diff.

meta.description: FY 2024-25 parity fixture: frozen pre-registry-refactor TaxEngine outputs (ADR-008, Sprint 2 Step A1). Regenerate only via tests/tools/generate_parity_snapshot.py.
meta.note: Outputs include the current crude 87A/surcharge relief-zone results; Step A2 updates those cells deliberately with citations. Hand edits to this file are rejected.

s2c_update.description: Step C (tax-expert rulings R-e/R-f, 2026-10-31): only the annotated cells were re-pinned — the Section 112A ₹1,25,000 exemption is now deducted ONCE across the AGGREGATE of all equity_ltcg entries (12.5% on the excess) instead of per entry. STCG/property cells and every CG-income-derived pin are byte-identical to the A2 snapshot; verify with git diff.

s2d_update.description: Step D (tax-expert ruling R-g, 2026-10-31): only the annotated cells were re-pinned — Section 80G is category-driven, and an uncategorized donation defaults to category 4 (50% subject to the 10% adjusted-GTI qualifying limit) instead of booking the full declared amount. Every changed cell donates 1,00,000 uncategorized; the new-regime pins and all non-80G cells are byte-identical; verify with git diff.
